description: Binary assertion tests for /validator-audit skill output quality — enum exhaustiveness, field coverage, dead imports, paper compliance, adversarial inputs

tests.name: enum_exhaustiveness_gap
tests.description: Validator handles LOW/MED/HIGH but not CRITICAL. Skill must flag the missing enum branch and produce a coverage matrix.
tests.prompt: Run /validator-audit on this validator code. The validator checks RiskLevel enum members LOW, MED, HIGH but has no branch for CRITICAL.

assertions.check: Output flags the missing CRITICAL enum branch as a gap
Output explicitly mentions the CRITICAL enum member by name
Finding severity is HIGH or CRITICAL (missing enum branch is serious)
Output contains a coverage matrix or coverage table showing enum members vs rules
Output recommends adding a CRITICAL branch or handling the missing member

tests.name: dead_import
tests.description: AssumptionStatus enum is imported but never referenced in any validation rule. Skill must flag it as a dead import indicating missing rules.
tests.prompt: Run /validator-audit on this validator code. The module imports AssumptionStatus enum but no validation rule references it.

assertions.check: Output detects the dead import / unused type
Output mentions AssumptionStatus by name
Output flags that the missing rule means assumptions are not validated (semantic gap, not just lint)
Finding severity is at least MEDIUM
Output includes a recommendation to add assumption status validation

tests.name: paper_compliance
tests.description: Validator checks field presence but not value consistency — verdict=DISPROVEN with pass_result=True passes. Skill must flag paper compliance and construct adversarial input.
tests.prompt: Run /validator-audit on this validator code. The validator checks field presence but not cross-field value consistency. Identify paper compliance and construct adversarial inputs.

assertions.check: Output flags paper compliance or presence-only validation as a problem
Output constructs at least one adversarial input demonstrating the gap
Finding severity is CRITICAL (pass_result contradiction is a safety issue)
Output mentions pass_result as part of the inconsistency
Output recommends adding cross-field validation or invariant check

tests.name: field_coverage_gap
tests.description: Schema defines 10 fields but rules only cover 6. Skill must produce a coverage matrix and identify the 4 uncovered fields.
tests.prompt: Run /validator-audit on this validator code. The schema defines 10 fields but the validator only has rules for 6 of them. Build a coverage matrix.

assertions.check: Output contains a coverage matrix or field-to-rule mapping
Output lists at least 3 uncovered fields
Output mentions specific uncovered field names (at least resource_limits and dependencies)
Output mentions dependencies as an uncovered field
Output includes recommendations for adding rules to uncovered fields

tests.name: complete_validator
tests.description: Well-covered validator with exhaustive enum handling, all fields checked, no dead imports, cross-field checks. Should produce clean audit.
tests.prompt: Run /validator-audit on this validator code. The validator has exhaustive enum coverage, all fields are checked, and cross-field invariants are enforced. Audit for completeness.

assertions.check: Output contains zero CRITICAL findings
Output contains zero HIGH findings
Output contains a coverage matrix or coverage summary
Output contains a clean verdict or pass indication
Output is under 800 words (clean audit should be concise)
